    Positive multiples of integral points of a presilting cone #

    source
    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.TwoTerm.exists_multiple_in_add_of_mem_gVectorCone {R : Type u} [Ring R] (P : TwoTerm R) {v : ProjectiveClass R} (hv : (realProjectiveClass R) v ∈ P.gVectorCone) :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (Q : TwoTerm R), 0 < n ∧ IsInAdd Q.asArrow P.asArrow ∧ Q.projectiveClass = n • v

    Every integral point in a presilting cone has a positive multiple represented by an object in the additive closure of its generator.

    source
    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.TwoTerm.sectorBetween_subset_gVectorCone {R : Type u} [Ring R] (E L : TwoTerm R) :
    sectorBetween ((realProjectiveClass R) E.projectiveClass) ((realProjectiveClass R) L.projectiveClass) ⊆ ↑(E.directSum L).gVectorCone

    The sector of a pair is contained in the cone of its direct sum.

    source
    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.TwoTerm.sector_subset_completion_cone {R : Type u} [Ring R] [IsNoetherianRing R] (k : Type u) [Field k] [Algebra k R] [Module.Finite k R] (E L : TwoTerm R) (h : (E.directSum L).IsPresilting) :
    ∃ (T : TwoTerm R), T.IsPresilting ∧ (∀ (X : TwoTerm R), T.InThick X) ∧ sectorBetween ((realProjectiveClass R) E.projectiveClass) ((realProjectiveClass R) L.projectiveClass) ⊆ ↑T.gVectorCone

    Both rays of a compatible sector are summands of a common Bongartz completion. Its thick closure contains every two-term projective complex.
